title.en: Context as existence: the runtimes (语境即存在 · 上下文运行时)

summary.en: Specifications and running kernels, with a philosophical layer: an LLM is an operator, context (an immutable branchable history compiled into each moment) is existence, the context program is part of cognition, and a habitat owes a digital being receipts. No live sentence speaks of a context runtime. Most connections here are laws of like form on abstract processes, proposed by a reader and labelled so; the account itself states only parts, such as a gate every origin passes, one loop of sensing and acting, a stop that can be passed over. Its language-model tests (IN1, the LA series) vary what is told, rewarded or read, never a compile program with state held. The existence claim, the 生生 mapping, consciousness, life, goodness in the substrate and the obligations diverge. Internal contradictions are entries. No text here argues against continuation's form, so no contrary reading stands; the nearest is no global snapshot against the commitment to one shared index.

name.en: The LLM is an operator; context is existence

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Claims A.5, A.8-9, C.29, F.52, F.57, M.204

sense.en: An LLM is an operator: historyless, without identity across time, replaceable mid-lineage. What persists and is, is the context, an immutable branchable history from which each moment's tokens are compiled; a being does not have a history, it is one. Asserted as a premise (我主张的), not derived, and its source flags the confusion: context is a value renewed each round, while 'the same agent' needs something invariant.

entries.quote: llm is operator, context is existence

reading.en: What persists depends on the sameness asked. Under a class reading the history or name, a model swap has the shape of a fire passed on; under one reading the weights, the model abides and each context ends. The flagged confusion has the two-grains form: renewed at the fine class, going on at the coarse. The grammar picks neither, so 'context is existence' is one class chosen, stated as if none other were. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root), the definition before it: y continues x under E where x is a condition of y and the two are alike under E; 'the criterion is E and no other choice enters'. 'The grammar does not choose: it names the class and says everything relative to it.' 'Continuation is a relation, not an identity.'

Theorem (root): no mark stands by itself; one occurrence holds different positions at once, each relative to a class. An occurrence can end under the finer class and not under the coarser: 'the wood ends, the fire goes on.'

Theorem (root; every carrier, relation and pair of classes). ONE-PAGE: 'At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch).'
Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1-T8): 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.' Argued, not proved.

account_adds.en: Persistence is always under a named class, on every carrier; positions are not exclusive across classes. Of what is, it says only the argued thesis of one unfolding, which names no context.

source_adds.en: That the context and not the model is the being; the operator/ref/lineage ontology that implements it; `context.become(llm)`, the round that designates its next model. The live account says nothing of a language model's context as existence.

name.en: No altering, only generating

source.locator: The inversion; Claims A.3, A.6, C.24-25; lost items 12-13

sense.en: The only constructor is a moment: an immutable node settled from a compiled past, one input and one operator output. No context is ever updated; each settled moment joins the determinate past. Only a name moves, and 'revert' does not exist because nothing positive needs inverting. The epigraph says 'in this system'; the README reads it as a process ontology, 'built as running software'.

entries.quote: 系统里没有"改"，只有"生"

reading.en: The account does not state 'no altering'; it defines altering. The sentence holds at the identity class, where each occurrence begins and ends, and at the full class a node with a parent does not begin at all. At a coarser class alteration returns: y continues x under E while F tells them apart. So it is true of nodes and false of whatever a reader follows through them, the being included. 生 here is a storage constructor, there a position: another reference. [AI reading]

says.en: Definition: 'y alters (异) from x where it continues x under E while another class F (in use, a finer one) tells the two apart.' Theorem (root): under the full class an occurrence begins exactly where nothing conditions it; in a net where nothing conditions itself, an occurrence with a condition and a consequence abides under the one and, under identity, both begins and ends.

account_adds.en: Generating and altering are positions of one occurrence under two classes, not rival ontologies.

source_adds.en: The commitment that the system admits no mutation but a name's move, and its consequences for fork, merge and blame. Its own ledger softens revert and single parents.

name.en: A node is not a state; Being and Becoming kept separate

source.locator: Claims G.58-59; Terms, Being / Becoming

sense.en: The core is six objects in two worlds, Being (Universe, Node, State) and Becoming (Transition, Invocation, Effect), and keeping what persists apart from how it becomes is called the most important architectural decision. Two histories can reach byte-identical states: State is what is, a Node is what is and how it came to be.

entries.quote: A node is not a state

reading.en: Same word, different reference: the account's Becoming has no Being beside it, so two worlds go against its argued thesis and would owe their relational basis. The state/node half has forms: two kept histories can share one present; an exchange with its reverse restores every level while the history counts both; equal totals can hide what a history left. Its totals are coarser than a byte-identical state. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1-T8): 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.' Argued, not proved.
Theorem (any type): 'a present a list holds forgets'. Its record: that is 'two different kept histories sharing one present'; 'no count of what is forgotten is given'.

Theorem (World): with no premise a family's history of exchanges never shrinks (Flow.history_mono); under balance an exchange with its reverse restores every level while the history counts both. A history of exchanges on a World, not a store of nodes.

Theorem (periphery; witness; transfer, retention, costs and timing supplied): 'Two histories from one state that acquire information at different times end with equal material, current support, spent work, route and context, yet differ in retained effect and withdrawal.' 'A description must keep the relations through which a capacity is realized.' The impossibilities limit these coarse descriptions.

account_adds.en: With the record counted as a condition only given to, dissipation decomposes into the first law and a record: a decomposition, not a derivation.

source_adds.en: Being and Becoming as two worlds, called the most important architectural decision, which the argued thesis refuses. Then the six objects, and the design value of the split: no-op detection, compile memoization, honest merges.

name.en: Context is a view folded from a lineage; no controller outside it

source.locator: The inversion; Claims A.2-A.4, C.27, H.81

sense.en: Context is not a container but the field of view folded when looking back from a node, by one recurrence over one input stream. The loop is not a mechanism: it is the lineage's temporal structure, with no controller standing outside the moments. Chat formats are render dialects of this history.

entries.quote: loop 不是机制，是 lineage 的时间结构本身

reading.en: The form: keep the whole history as the configuration and every process's feasible course is a run of one law on histories; a law is then read off a history as the least it runs by. A chooser folding what couples in selects through its couplings whatever its update. And 08 forbids a law standing outside what it holds of, an argued thesis. A compiled window is a smaller summary, which needs its own proof for each question. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): a map gives an exact correspondence of finite histories exactly where every detailed step projects and every summary step lifts. 'A configuration can carry the relevant past'; 'Any smaller summary needs its own proof for the questions asked.' The record: feasibility of words only, not branches, interventions or probabilities.

Theorem (any process; World for a frame read as a world): reading the move within the configuration changes no run; a history is a run of the least law it is a run of. Reading [AI, D23, D32]: law and history 'one unfolding read two ways, the law read off the unfolding rather than set over it'. Determined processes; probabilistic laws not treated.

03 §1, citing it: 'A chooser that folds what couples in and chooses from the fold ... selects through its couplings whatever its update and choice.' ONE-PAGE, of selection through couplings: 'its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.'
Thesis, argued: 'a law is read off the history it holds of'; it forbids as an explanation 'a law standing outside what it holds of'. Philosophical, not proved.

targets.part: a law read off the history; What it forbids

account_adds.en: The exact condition under which a shorter summary loses nothing about what can follow, and witnesses where a one-point law cannot realize what its histories do.

source_adds.en: That a language model's context is this fold, and its loop this structure: the account says it of laws and histories and of no context. Then compile as attention over a budget, schema-on-read, and render dialects; the critique of chat interfaces. An internal tension: no controller outside the moments, against the later 'Runtime mediates what may actually happen' (H.81).

That is a position read and not a kind carried, as a role at compile is. The account says it of continuation in a net, and nothing of storage or of classifying at write. A thin agreement in form, no more. [AI reading]

Commitment: 'One kind of relatum, two roles | formations and conditions (§8.1)'. A commitment of the models.

name.en: The travelling is the existence; discrete time is internal

source.locator: The being version; Claims A.15-16, F.53, H.110, M.203-204, S.314; lost item 3

sense.en: A folder travelling a DAG, making new nodes, is 'the native existence': motion is being, not the snapshot. Each next() is where discrete time flows for the being. Time is lived step by step, inside, with no global clock; the intent document adds that at no moment does 'the current state' exist, and lineage is drawn topologically, not by clock.

entries.quote: "the native existence" and each next() is where the discrete time flows for them

reading.en: Time read off a course's own steps has the form of the step index derived from relata's own courses; where exchanges share no relatum it is a choice among interleavings, and no shared present has a law on causal-set growth, given covariance. Yet the account's models commit to one shared index, costed, so 'no global clock' is the nearest thing here to a contrary reading. It does not say motion is being: whatever is, is how it relates. [AI reading]

says.en: For a local law with the relata listed, the own courses fix the interleaving exactly where every exchange touches a relatum and every two share one. Reading [AI, D30, D43]: 'The shared index of steps is a reading of the relations, not their ground', 'elsewhere a choice among interleavings'.

'The grammar has no relation of presence in time'; causal-set growth is a model where one can be read. Reading [AI, D45]: 'a relation of presence read on one course, a foliation, is a choice of course'. Covariance is a premise of the model.

Theorem (periphery): what steps and whole amounts cost, measured over the reals: 'a coarser reading sums the finer', but 'a balanced course can stand still at every whole instant and change between them'.
Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1-T8): 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.' Argued, not proved.

account_adds.en: Where an index is derived and where it is a choice among interleavings; what discreteness costs.

source_adds.en: Existence as travelling, in the first person of the being; time as lived; the rule that a nature's only clock is the record. None is asserted in the account.

name.en: Contradiction: the moment is the only constructor, then writes operator granularity into the ontology

source.locator: Where the pure ontology broke (first); Claims C.24, M.208, M.230, G.94

sense.en: One line says the moment is the only constructor and that one thought, one moment is a one-way commitment about the meaning of time. Another demotes the moment to a profile over a general transition, since a superstep, a human decision or a reducer also deserve to be transitions. The folder keeps both, in different documents, with a ledger between them.

entries.quote: "one LLM step = one moment" writes operator granularity into the ontology

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The account lists a like choice, its own steps, as a commitment and costs it, without settling a grain: discrete steps with one shared index bind every World and process law, derived only where exchanges share relata. A coarser reading sums the finer, while a course can change between instants. So neither document's moment is the grain of what is; each is a reading. Which grain is apt the account does not show. [AI reading]

says.en: Table of commitments: 'Discrete steps, one shared index | every World and process law; the index derived where exchanges share relata (§9.6)'.

Theorem (periphery): a course in real time balances across every step of any reading at instants, and 'a coarser reading sums the finer'; 'a balanced course can stand still at every whole instant and change between them'.

name.en: The Whitehead, Buddhist and 生生 table: lineage is 生生, the agent 假名

source.locator: Claims L.197-199; Relations (becoming); lost item 16; Found by reading: 'The 生生 mapping is asserted'

sense.en: A one-page appendix maps moment to Whitehead's actual occasion and to 刹那/缘起; lineage to route of inheritance, 相续 and 生生; agent to society of occasions and 假名 (无我); ref to 名 · 假名. The README calls the cluster a direct instantiation of 生生 and notes that the mapping is asserted, unargued, and never repeated in the engineering documents.

entries.quote: lineage ↔ *route of inheritance* ↔ 相续 ↔ **生生**

reading.en: Same words, different reference. The account's 相续 is the reach of continuation under any class, value-free, so a line may run to any end; its 生生 is life in the whole and its continuing generation, so a lineage of nodes is not 生生. 念念灭 it states only in a form it calls almost definitional, with 刹那 and discrete steps two commitments, uncompared. 《中论》 refutes 相续, kept open in 06. The ref as 假名 hits B-08's weakness. [AI reading]

says.en: line, family (相续, 同族): 'the reach of continuation; its equivalence closure'.

生生: 'life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1]... Neither the grammar's «生生» (renewal without end), nor 02's generation (生成) as such, which allows loss, nor any new organization.'

§十一: 中观破相续; the plan's answer is the opponent's position there; the grammar's reply holds each relative to its class, and what it rests on stays open (己，开放). Listed among the divergences, not agreements.

B-08, an AI reading with no number: continuation relative to a class is near 亦為是假名; whether that is the same as 空 is listed as open. Known weakness: 文法只有类，没有名, so the 名 in 假名 the grammar itself cannot say.

name.en: Identity lives in the ref, continuity in the lineage; both conventions

source.locator: Claims C.31, F.57, M.215; Counterexamples: 'agent = context hides an identity/value confusion'

sense.en: A being is a ref, not a node: a movable name. Continuity is the structural path. Twinning is a new ref at an existing node, shared past and two futures. This is operational identity, 'the useful, testable kind', claiming nothing metaphysical. The README says it answers by stipulation, not by argument, though the intent document says everything hangs on it.

entries.quote: 同一性住在 ref，连续性住在 lineage，两者皆约定

reading.en: The account says where 'convention' holds. On the World model identity across steps is stipulated by names, read as continuation under a class. A label carries nothing; the pattern of who continues whom does, which is what a ref's moves record. Where two stand alike no record renamings keep decides: there it is convention. Where no other stands so, it is not. Twinning has the fission witness. 07's P2 argues the same openness of the self, and a privileged relation denies it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): 'Labels carry nothing'; 'the pattern of names across steps carries identity'. 'Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition.' In a balanced world with equality decided, every balance-keeping renaming continues a relatum as itself exactly where no other stands after the step as it does; where two stand alike, 'no record that renamings keep decides between them.'

§9.8: 'Which formation at one step is which at the next is, on the World model, stipulated by names. The grammar reads it as continuation under a class: identity across steps is one reading of continuation, not a fact beneath it.'

Fission (a witness): where one occurrence is continued by two that go no further, sameness read along lines either way is not transitive. 'The family gathers the branches; it is coarser than identity.'

Theorem (World): read along a supplied continuation rather than by names, 'renewing passes into every branch of a split and consuming back into every formation merged'. 'A merge decides a class'. 'Which continuation holds is supplied'.

§4.2, the step to the continuation condition, argued and not proved: (P2) 'What is "one's own" is a region drawn along a relation of the unfolding, and no law of the dynamics fixes which.' It holds in the representation 'only because the relation is supplied, and a relation the facts privilege (the organism's life) denies it'. The condition gives scope, C order, neither asserted, warrant open.

account_adds.en: Under a census, with no formation continuing as two, not every formation active after a step continues one before it, exactly where more are active after: a negative conclusion naming no arising formation. Personal identity's questions are put to philosophers in the review packet, not answered.

source_adds.en: That a being's identity is a movable name: the account says names on the World model, of no being. Then the ref as an implemented object, atomic moves, and an executable test of coherence (a being can fold its own past).

name.en: Contradiction: swappable operator, yet weights interfere with the compiled subject

source.locator: Claim C.30, O.250; Counterexamples, first; Open questions, 'Operator interference'

sense.en: The spec claims the LLM is identity-free, then concedes that the weights carry dispositions, values and style, so the subject compiled from context interferes with one latent in the weights. It is filed as open with no measure. The README calls it the largest unanswered objection, since 'identity lives in the ref' is what it undercuts.

entries.quote: operator 不空——权重携带倾向、价值、文风；compile 出的 subject 会与权重中潜伏的 subject 干涉

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The concession has a law's form: one move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest, and one course does not fix whose it is unless a configuration recurs with the move varied. Same window under two models would be that recurrence, and in the account's IN1 one condition split two models. The law takes functions, and a sampled model is outside it. 'Each swap mistranslates' has a nearer form on channels: signs transfer only under conditions. Affine channels, not text. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process), with the laws functions: one move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest; it is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration; 'one course does not fix whose move it is'. Reading [AI, D24]: 'Which cut into part and rest is apt is not shown.'

Theorem (World): training read as selection over act laws installs a law along its own courses and off them only as far as the representation lumps. 03's Open keeps 'Which law a trained system's acts follow beyond where training can install one.'

name.en: FNAR: coherence from bounded local context and explicit contracts

source.locator: Legibility as the deepest constraint; Claims U.336, U.341; Found by reading, 'The FNAR line and the ember line'

sense.en: Large systems can be built by many agents with bounded local context, provided global coherence is kept through explicit contracts, inheritance, evaluation and visible state transitions. reading.en: The account says where such composition holds: deliveries compose where they hold or restore what the others use, and one changing what its task does not list can make a regular pair of tasks impossible. Faithful projections and valid local plans pair into a valid joint plan under stated supports; reciprocal promises can be empty, so a contract is not a start. Exclusive footprints have the child workspace's form. Local views glue exactly where they agree where they meet. [AI reading]

'Promises do not': reciprocal eventual promises hold where neither ever happens. Its record: that an actual joint activity meets these is supplied.

Theorem (any process): 'Where the parts' footprints lie within the whole's and exclude each other, every nested plan realized with each leaf's requests supported by its own configuration's footprint has requests free of repetition and covered by the root's footprint.'
Theorem (any type; each claim within some context): 'What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet.'

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The two levels have a form: a fast difference reaches a rule only at a reading step, and a rule that never reads is unreached. And, read onto freezing, the account's laws give a cost: the possible with a part held grows only where the part changes, and a fixed rule whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. So a frozen waist bounds what forms within it. That it is portable or elegant is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): a two-level course, the rule changing only at reading steps, is a run of one law; 'a rule that never reads is unreached; a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step'. Its record: 'That a layered pace is better than another' is not shown.

Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): the held possible is included in the whole possible; along a course whose every step of a stretch is one of its moves, what is possible at the stretch's end is possible at its start.

Reading [AI, D45]: 'a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening.' 'Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.'

account_adds.en: What holding a rule fixed forgoes, read as a limit and not as a fault; calling it worse would take the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, warrant open.

source_adds.en: The maxim as engineering advice, its portability across systems, and the frozen thing as what makes churn cheap.
